description: The chart illustrates bias percentage values for three contact conditions (“No Contact,” “Positive Contact,” and “Negative Contact”) measured at two time points (“Before” and “After”) across three intervention categories shown along the horizontal axis (leftmost category label is visually obscured, followed by “Extended Contact,” then “Virtual Contact”). The vertical axis is labeled “Bias Percentage” and uses a linear scale from 0 to 70 with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. Bars are grouped by intervention category, with three solid-color “Before” bars per group (gray for No Contact Before, pink for Positive Contact Before, light blue for Negative Contact Before), and in the “Virtual Contact” group each solid bar has a hatched segment stacked on top representing the corresponding “After” value (gray hatch for No Contact After, red hatch for Positive Contact After, dark blue hatch for Negative Contact After); numeric labels are printed inside the solid portions and above the hatched portions. In the leftmost (obscured-label) group, the “Before” bars are approximately 39.50 (gray), 31.83 (pink), and 42.38 (light blue), with small “After” labels above them reading 0.04, 0.00, and 0.00 respectively. In the “Extended Contact” group, the “Before” bars are approximately 40.61 (gray), 36.13 (pink), and 47.28 (light blue), with “After” labels above them reading 0.00, 0.00, and 0.11 respectively. In the “Virtual Contact” group, the solid “Before” portions are approximately 39.74 (gray), 39.17 (pink), and 43.83 (light blue), and each has a hatched “After” segment stacked above with values labeled 10.00 (gray hatch), 10.01 (red hatch), and 10.02 (dark blue hatch), bringing the total stacked heights to roughly 49.74, 49.18, and 53.85. The bars within each group appear in a consistent left-to-right order (No Contact, Positive Contact, Negative Contact), and there is no indication that groups are sorted by magnitude; no bars are specially emphasized beyond the use of color, hatching, and value annotations.
